context: Friends plan a winter shrine visit and festival
purpose: Plan the outing; teach まいり/時半/パワー/覆/サン/ロー/アウト/ロック

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 明日、神社におまいり行かない？
lines.en: Want to go pray at the shrine tomorrow?
lines.style: easygoing friend floating a fun plan

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね！ 何時に集合する？
lines.en: Nice! What time should we meet?
lines.style: enthusiastic friend jumping on board, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: How about seven-thirty at the station?
lines.style: practical friend pinning down logistics, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 了解。あそこ、有名なパワースポットだよね。
lines.en: Got it. That place is a famous power spot, right?
lines.style: excited friend recalling its reputation, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、山が雪に覆われてて景色も最高らしい。
lines.en: Yeah, the mountain is blanketed in snow and stunning.
lines.style: anticipating friend painting the scene, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 雪の照り返しがすごいから、サングラス持ってく。
lines.en: The snow glare is intense, so I’ll bring sunglasses.
lines.style: prepared friend thinking ahead practically, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ローカルなお祭りもやってるみたいだよ。
lines.en: Seems there’s a local festival on too.
lines.style: informed friend adding a bonus draw

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 屋台もあるし、アウトドア気分で楽しもう。
lines.en: There are stalls too; let’s enjoy the outdoor vibe.
lines.style: upbeat friend setting the mood, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 夜はロックバンドのステージもあるんだって。
lines.en: They say there’s a rock band stage at night too.
lines.style: thrilled friend saving the best detail
